# algolia_indices (Data Source)

Use this data source to list every index in the Algolia application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algolia_indices" "example" {}

output "index_names" {
  value = [for index in data.algolia_indices.example.indices : index.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this listing. Set to the Algolia application ID.
- `indices` (Attributes List) Every index in the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--indices))

<a id="nestedatt--indices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `indices`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Index creation date. An empty string means the index has no records.
- `data_size` (Number) Number of bytes of the index in minified format.
- `entries` (Number) Number of records contained in the index.
- `file_size` (Number) Number of bytes of the index binary file.
- `last_build_time_s` (Number) Last build time, in seconds.
- `name` (String) Index name.
- `number_of_pending_tasks` (Number) Number of pending indexing operations. Deprecated by the API; should not be relied upon.
- `pending_task` (Boolean) Whether the index has pending tasks. Deprecated by the API; should not be relied upon.
- `primary` (String) Only present if the index is a replica. Name of the related primary index.
- `replicas` (List of String) Only present if the index is a primary index with replicas. Names of all linked replicas.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time when the index was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.
- `virtual` (Boolean) Only present if the index is a virtual replica.
